name: termdash-4b322f4b-blind30-ots
instr:
# A terminal dashboard toolkit gone quietly wrong, without a test suite

The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything that was noticed from the outside, written up by what someone was doing at the time.

Nothing about the terminal changed and nothing about the calling programs changed, yet interactions that used to come out right now come out wrong, and in two places something that used to be accepted is refused outright.

Sitting in front of a live screen and working it by hand. Pressing a key no longer refreshes anything: the component under the pointer plainly receives the keypress, but the terminal keeps showing whatever it showed before the key arrived, while asking for a repaint by hand still updates it exactly as it always did. Rolling the wheel over a chronological list of entries still steps down three rows a notch, but rolling back up stops one row short of the top and never gets to the very beginning. In a set of mutually exclusive choices, clicking the first entry does nothing whatsoever — the click comes back reported as unhandled and the state behind it does not change — while clicking any later entry in the same set works as it always did. Creating a clickable text control while asking for zero horizontal room around its text now fails outright as invalid; one or more is accepted, and the sizes reported when that room is left at its default are as before.
